description: Fingerprints for the published Calgary data. The editorial-only removal is documented below; statistical values and geometry are preserved.

transformations.operation: Remove editorial community-selection advice from the public dataset.
transformations.validation: Parsed output was deeply compared to the previous published collection after deleting only properties.note. Every geometry, official statistic, source, identifier and data caveat is unchanged.

transformations.operation: Round geometry coordinates to 5 decimal places (about 1 m; under one pixel at maximum zoom 17) with scripts/round-coordinates.mjs to cut download size. Properties, identifiers, statistics, centroid and labelPoint anchors are unchanged; consecutive vertices that became identical were merged and rings stay closed.
transformations.validation: The script checked every output vertex is an input vertex rounded, in order, and deep-compared every feature's properties; npm run check then re-verified counts, coordinate ranges and that every community display anchor is still inside its boundary.
